example.name: database_performance_optimization
example.description: Complete workflow for optimizing slow database queries and improving response times
example.context: When users report slow API responses and database analysis reveals inefficient queries

actions.action: Use codebase_search to find database queries and slow endpoints
Read configuration files to understand current database setup
Identify N+1 query patterns and missing indexes
Create load test scenarios for identified slow endpoints
Execute load tests to establish baseline performance metrics
Document current response times and throughput
Optimize SQL queries by adding proper WHERE clauses
Add database indexes for frequently queried columns
Implement query result caching where appropriate
Re-run load tests to measure performance improvements
Compare results against baseline metrics
Document performance gains and optimization impact

example.title: Before: Inefficient query with N+1 problem
example.code: -- Slow query causing N+1 problem SELECT u.*, p.* FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.status = 'active';

example.title: After: Optimized query with proper indexing

expected_outcomes.outcome: Response time improved from 2.1s to 0.3s (85% improvement)
Database load reduced by 60% through query optimization
System can handle 3x more concurrent users

actions.action: Identify frequently accessed API endpoints
Analyze data freshness requirements for each endpoint
Determine appropriate cache TTL values
Implement Redis caching layer for API responses
Add cache invalidation logic for data updates
Create cache warming strategies for critical endpoints
Load test cached endpoints to verify performance gains
Test cache invalidation and refresh mechanisms
Monitor cache hit rates and memory usage

example.title: Redis caching implementation

expected_outcomes.outcome: API response time reduced by 70% for cached endpoints
